day_shape: 66 items: Houthi missile/drone strikes on Riyadh and Aramco's Yanbu with Iran-supplied radars reported, Iran sets seven conditions for US talks, Tehran regime rally draws hundreds of thousands, IDF kills Hamas Rafah and Byouk commanders, no UK or OFAC output.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: Houthi forces claimed ballistic-missile and drone strikes on a Saudi Aramco facility in Yanbu and sites in Riyadh, with Gulf stocks opening lower and the US issuing a citizen security advisory. Jerusalem Post cited Al-Ain reporting that Iran installed radar systems used by the Houthis in the attacks.

threads.label: Iran conditions for US talks
threads.summary: Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei said Iran had conveyed seven conditions to Washington via mediators for resuming negotiations to end the war with the US. Speaker Qalibaf said Iran must "both fight and negotiate," while the parliament's national security chief warned the US against "repeating the miscalculation."

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and oil pressure
threads.summary: Iran said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until its conditions are met, while CENTCOM marked over 2,000 commercial ships escorted through the waterway. Iran International reported sharp falls in Iranian oil loadings forcing production curbs, as IRGC Deputy Commander Izadi claimed the strait is under "complete control."

threads.label: IDF strikes Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed killing Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid and Hamas military-wing commander Muhammad Suleiman Byouk in Gaza strikes, and reported the son of Hamas-linked health ministry head Munir Al-Bursh killed. Two IDF soldiers were lightly injured by a Hezbollah roadside bomb in south Lebanon, prompting retaliatory strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure.

threads.label: Tehran rally and internal security
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported hundreds of thousands attended a regime-organised rally in Tehran, described by LA Times as the largest defiance display since the US-Israel strikes on Iran. Iran's Intelligence Ministry claimed dismantling three operational cells tied to "American-Zionist" groups, while Iran International reported the mobilisation drive extending to children under 15.

threads.label: West Bank shooting attack
threads.summary: The IDF said soldiers were pursuing a gunman after a shooting attack in the Neve Tzuf settlement area, establishing roadblocks. IRIB, citing Arab media, reported one Israeli killed and others seriously injured in the attack on "Nowe Tsof," with the attacker fleeing the scene.

threads.label: Opposition and defection claims
threads.summary: Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi told the Jerusalem Post that members of the Islamic Republic's military and civilian establishment were "quietly breaking" with the regime in what he called an "active defection" phase. Pakistani and Iranian foreign ministers agreed to meet in New York.
